lines.text: James tells the brothers to be patient like a farmer who waits for the fall and spring rains.
James says the Judge is standing at the door, and he holds up the prophets and Job as examples of perseverance.
James says not to swear, to sing praises when cheerful, and to call the deacons of the church when sick.
James says the prayer offered in faith will restore the sick, and Elijah prayed that it would not rain for three and a half months.
After Elijah prayed again, the heavens gave rain, and whoever turns a sinner from error will save his soul from death.
